'''Enchant Crossbow Bolts (Diamond)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 57 to cast. It imbues 10 [[diamond bolts]] or [[diamond dragon bolts]] each cast and turns them into [[diamond bolts (e)]] or [[diamond dragon bolts (e)]] respectively. The enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering an effect that increases the max hit by 15% while guaranteeing a [[successful hit]]. They are very useful when fighting enemies with high defence, like [[metal dragons]] or creatures in the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]], especially when they are relatively cheap to buy.
